verdict.rationale: Sentry's homepage says its Seer debugging agent 'fixes what's broken while you ship what's next', generating merge-ready patches. That implies some autonomous background agent work, but the only evidence is a thin marketing claim, with no documentation of users setting up or configuring automations. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable automation setup, triggers or schedules, controls for background execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Fixes what’s broken while you ship what’s next – generating precise, merge-ready patches.
Find root causes and fix production issues with [Seer, our debugging agent](https://sentry.io/product/seer/).
